definition: a boxy road vehicle for carrying people or things
description: A series of shots from life in a camper van. A curly-haired young man leans out of the open side door of a white van with a shaggy grey dog beside him, the blue ocean and a beach behind them. A drone shot follows the van along a winding coastal road at sunset. Then, on a bare clifftop at dusk, three friends sit on folding chairs around a small open fire built inside a ring of pale stones; the flames burn orange in the middle of the circle and light their faces while a dog sleeps on a blanket beside them and the van stands with its door open behind. Later the friends and the dog sprint across the wet sand of a beach, and at the end they sit together on the open tailgate of the van watching the sun drop into the sea.
transcript: Hey kids, it's your dad here. I've been on the road for four years now. The things that make life special aren't the things you own, they're the people beside you and the memories you make along the way.
